# RepuAI - Optimize Your Brand's Visibility in AI Search Engines

The first AI-powered brand monitoring tool designed for AI search engines. Track your brand presence in ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini and optimize for better visibility. Get started now to dominate AI search.

## Overview

[RepuAI](https://repuai.live/): A cutting-edge tool that helps brands monitor and enhance their visibility across various AI search engines, ensuring they maintain a strong online presence.

## Problem

[Problem](https://repuai.live/#problem): Discusses the challenges brands face in maintaining visibility in the rapidly evolving landscape of AI search engines, highlighting the need for effective monitoring and optimization strategies.

## Solution

[Solution](https://repuai.live/#solution): Outlines how RepuAI addresses the visibility issues faced by brands, providing innovative features that allow for real-time tracking and optimization of brand presence in AI search environments.

## Features

[Features](https://repuai.live/#features): Details the key functionalities of RepuAI, including brand tracking, performance analytics, and optimization tools tailored for AI search engines.

## Tools

- [LLMs.txt Generator](https://repuai.live/generators/llms): A tool to generate `llms.txt` and `llms-full.txt` files for your website to provide clear instructions and context to LLMs.

## Audience

[Audience](https://repuai.live/#pricing): Identifies the target users of RepuAI, including businesses and marketers looking to enhance their brand visibility in AI-driven search platforms.

## Testimonials

[Testimonials](https://repuai.live/#testimonials): Showcases feedback and success stories from users who have benefited from using RepuAI, illustrating its effectiveness in improving brand visibility.
